_comment: EXAMPLE -- copy to crate-aliases.json and edit. That real file holds your site's IPs and is gitignored; this example is the tracked one. The IPs below are the NAT-MCH factory default, so a crate left unchanged is reachable on a bench network but indistinguishable from its neighbour -- give each crate its real address.
_port: not configured: the exporter port is derived from the name (MCH1 -> 9291, TVT -> 9290) by src/mch_names.py
_disable: to park a crate, delete its entry or wrap it in /* */ -- the loader strips C-style comments
